purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
decision_rule: Report fitting versus excluded-family errors by phase and all required diagnostic slices. Use this to distinguish small-neural-head fitting failure from broader public-representation/generalization failure. No pooled result, fitting result or tree feature importance can establish final acceptance.
scope: Training-only public-representation and fitting-capacity probe with absolute-error histogram gradient boosting. Same864causal public spatial/history features, corrected sources, family exclusions and phase weights. No early stopping, validation split, overtime override, or neural residual cap. Fixed100iterations and15leaves, no label-driven sweep. Tree leaf sample counts refer to decision rows, not independent games. No model promotion.
